newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya produces 3,600 trucks and buses yearly.
newsitem.headline: Libya produces 3,600 trucks and buses yearly.

text.p: Libya is producing 3,600 trucks and buses yearly in an assembling plant in which Italy's Iveco has a 25-percent stake, an official at the company said on Monday.

"We produce 3,600 vehicles per year. The demand is so high that delivery to clients takes several months," Ramadhan el-Chibani, sales manager of Trucks & Bus Co. told Reuters here at a automobile exhibit.
Trucks & Bus Co is 75-percent owned by the Libyan Industry Ministry. Chibani would not disclose the amount of the firm's capital or turnover.
The plant, which started production in 1984, is located in Tajura, near Tripoli.
"Libyan-made components input ranges between 30 percent and 53 percent. The engines are imported from Iveco and some other components from Tunisia," Chibani said.
